Reading the graph

Km is an operational constant: the [S] giving ½Vmax. It depends on the rate constants (k₁, k₋₁, k₂), so it is not always the binding dissociation constant.

Vmax = kcat × [E]total: the ceiling when every enzyme is working.

A competitive inhibitor competes with substrate for the active site: apparent Km = Km(1 + [I]/Ki). Vmax is unchanged, but reaching it needs much more substrate. The curve shifts right, and more [S] outcompetes the inhibitor.
